note: Community offers for the public perks page, in three groups. available_now: terms are agreed and members will claim through a member link or code that stays off this public page; Sign in is not live, so claiming is not open on this page. coming_soon: a benefit is agreed, and the claim route or a remaining detail (plan, eligibility or cover) is still being set up. in_discussion: a live conversation with no agreed member benefit, so no discount, credit, seat count or percentage is stated. perks.headline: 6 months free, up to $25k
perks.offer: Eligible startups can get six months of Zendesk free, up to $25k per startup, through our place in the Zendesk for Startups programme. This is for new Zendesk customers with fewer than 250 employees, at Series B or earlier. Apply through the member link once claiming is open. Claiming is not open on this page, and the unique partner link is not published here.
perks.eligibility: New Zendesk customers, fewer than 250 employees, Series B or earlier. Approved for Remote Builders and BSTC as a startup partner.
perks.claim_status: Claiming is not open on this page. Unique partner links and member codes stay off this page until a member claim path is ready.
perks.notes: Includes Copilot assistance, AI agents with automated resolutions, 10 automated resolutions per agent per month, full API access, up to five help centres, and App Builder access. The public Zendesk for Startups programme is listed separately on this page.

perks.headline: 20% off the first year
perks.offer: If you are introduced through BSTC or Remote Builders before you sign, Carta offers 20% off the first year and waives implementation fees. The introduction has to happen before you sign, and it is not backdated. Request an intro through the community. Claiming is not open on this page, and no personal contact details are published here.
perks.eligibility: Companies referred through BSTC or Remote Builders. The introduction must happen before signing; it is not retroactive.
perks.claim_status: Request an introduction through the community before you sign. Claiming is not open on this page, and no personal contact details are published here.
perks.notes: The public Carta Launch programme is listed separately on this page, with its own cutoff: companies that have raised under $1 million and have under 25 stakeholders. If you also want Launch, apply on that card.
